```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE cm.model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cb.child_component_id, b.qty * cb.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = b.component_id AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = b.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.qty), 0) AS total_qty
FROM bom b
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = b.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

    FROM model_expansion me

WITH first_level AS (
  SELECT mb.component_id, mb.qty, mb.valid_from, mb.valid_to
  FROM model_bom mb
  JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mb.model_id
  WHERE cm.model_code = 'AE8-180WAL79-0758'

  WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-10-31' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-10-31' <= valid_to)

  WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)

SELECT c.component_code
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.component_id, cu.component_id) AS component_id,
         p.qty AS past_qty, cu.qty AS current_qty
  FROM past p
  FULL OUTER JOIN current cu ON p.component_id = cu.component_id
) diff

ORDER BY c.component_code

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each sold SKU into its underlying company models, multiplying quantities along composition paths
sku_models AS (
    -- Direct mapping: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT
        u.parent_code AS sku_code,
        u.child_code AS model_code,
        u.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition u
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.child_kind = 'model'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= u.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    -- Bundle SKU -> item SKU, then recurse to models
    SELECT
        u.parent_code AS sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        u.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN sku_models sm
      ON sm.sku_code = u.child_code
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= u.valid_to)
),
-- Aggregate model quantity per SKU (sum over all paths)
sku_model_qty AS (
    SELECT sku_code, model_code, SUM(qty) AS qty_per_sku
    FROM sku_models
    GROUP BY sku_code, model_code
)
SELECT
    SUM(ol.qty * smq.qty_per_sku) AS total_units
FROM orders o

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each sold order line down to company models, multiplying quantities through bundles
explode AS (
    -- Start: order lines -> SKU (with qty sold)
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        s.sku_code AS node_kind_code,
        'sku' AS node_kind,
        CAST(ol.qty AS DOUBLE) AS qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'CA'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'

    UNION ALL

    -- Traverse composition edges: sku -> sku (bundle), sku -> model, model -> component, component -> component
    SELECT
        e.order_id,
        e.line_no,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.child_kind,
        e.qty * uc.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = e.node_kind
     AND uc.parent_code = e.node_kind_code
     AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= uc.valid_to)
)

JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = e.node_kind_code
WHERE e.node_kind = 'model'
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(e.qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each order line into (model_code, qty) pairs, counting bundle contents
expanded AS (
    -- Base: order lines in JP, 2025, completed
    SELECT ol.listing_id, ol.qty AS line_qty, l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- Recursively expand SKU composition: bundle -> item SKU, non-bundle SKU -> model
sku_expand AS (
    -- Start from each sold SKU
    SELECT e.sku_id AS cur_kind_id, 'sku' AS cur_kind, e.line_qty AS qty
    FROM expanded e
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN u.child_kind = 'sku' THEN sk.sku_id
             WHEN u.child_kind = 'model' THEN cm.model_id
             ELSE NULL END,
        u.child_kind,
        se.qty * u.qty
    FROM sku_expand se
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON se.cur_kind = 'sku' AND sk.sku_id = se.cur_kind_id
    JOIN u_composition u 
      ON u.parent_kind = 'sku' 
     AND u.parent_code = sk.sku_code
     AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    LEFT JOIN company_model cm ON u.child_kind = 'model' AND cm.model_code = u.child_code
    WHERE se.cur_kind = 'sku'
),
-- Now expand models -> components (parts), summing quantities
model_parts AS (
    SELECT se.cur_kind_id AS model_id, se.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_expand se
    WHERE se.cur_kind = 'model'
),
-- Recursive component expansion from models
comp_expand AS (
    SELECT mp.model_id, mp.model_qty AS qty, cm.model_code AS model_code, 
           NULL::INT AS comp_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS comp_code, 0 AS depth
    FROM model_parts mp
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = mp.model_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ce.model_id, ce.qty * u.qty, ce.model_code,
           c.component_id, c.component_code, ce.depth + 1
    FROM comp_expand ce
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = ce.model_code
    JOIN u_composition u 
      ON u.parent_kind = 'model' 
     AND u.parent_code = cm.model_code
     AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = u.child_code
    WHERE ce.depth = 0
),
-- Continue expanding assembly components -> parts
comp_expand2 AS (
    SELECT ce.model_id, ce.qty, ce.model_code, ce.comp_id, ce.comp_code, ce.depth
    FROM comp_expand ce
    WHERE ce.comp_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ce2.model_id, ce2.qty * u.qty, ce2.model_code,
           c.component_id, c.component_code, ce2.depth + 1
    FROM comp_expand2 ce2
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = ce2.comp_id AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN u_composition u 
      ON u.parent_kind = 'component' 
     AND u.parent_code = c.component_code
     AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component c2 ON c2.component_code = u.child_code
),
-- Final: sum quantities per model (only parts, is_assembly = false)
model_sales AS (
    SELECT ce.model_code, SUM(ce.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM comp_expand2 ce
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = ce.comp_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = false
    GROUP BY ce.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_sales
ORDER BY total_qty DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Order lines in JP, 2025, completed
lines AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, ol.qty AS qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- Expand SKU -> model (handling bundles -> item SKUs -> models)
sku_to_model AS (
    -- non-bundle SKU directly maps to model
    SELECT l.sku_id, cm.model_code, l.qty * u.qty AS qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id AND sk.is_bundle = false
    JOIN u_composition u 
      ON u.parent_kind = 'sku' AND u.parent_code = sk.sku_code AND u.child_kind = 'model'
     AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = u.child_code
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT l.sku_id, cm.model_code, l.qty * ub.qty * u.qty AS qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id AND sk.is_bundle = true
    JOIN u_composition ub 
      ON ub.parent_kind = 'sku' AND ub.parent_code = sk.sku_code AND ub.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND ub.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (ub.valid_to IS NULL OR ub.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_code = ub.child_code AND item.is_bundle = false
    JOIN u_composition u 
      ON u.parent_kind = 'sku' AND u.parent_code = item.sku_code AND u.child_kind = 'model'
     AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_code = u.child_code
),
-- Expand model -> components recursively, tracking assembly status
comp_path AS (
    SELECT stm.model_code, stm.qty AS qty, c.component_id, c.component_code, c.is_assembly
    FROM sku_to_model stm
    JOIN u_composition u 
      ON u.parent_kind = 'model' AND u.parent_code = stm.model_code
     AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = u.child_code
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cp.model_code, cp.qty * u.qty, c.component_id, c.component_code, c.is_assembly
    FROM comp_path cp
    JOIN component pc ON pc.component_id = cp.component_id AND pc.is_assembly = true
    JOIN u_composition u 
      ON u.parent_kind = 'component' AND u.parent_code = pc.component_code
     AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = u.child_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM comp_path
WHERE is_assembly = false
GROUP BY model_code
ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Build the full composition graph (parent -> child x qty) valid as of 2026-10-01
edges AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_code, child_kind, child_code, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- For each SKU, explode down to company models
sku_to_model AS (
    WITH RECURSIVE walk(root_code, item_kind, item_code, qty) AS (
        SELECT parent_code, child_kind, child_code, CAST(qty AS DOUBLE)
        FROM edges
        WHERE parent_kind = 'sku'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w.root_code, e.child_kind, e.child_code, w.qty * e.qty
        FROM walk w
        JOIN edges e
          ON e.parent_kind = w.item_kind AND e.parent_code = w.item_code
    )
    SELECT root_code AS sku_code, item_code AS model_code, SUM(qty) AS qty_per_unit
    FROM walk
    WHERE item_kind = 'model'
    GROUP BY root_code, item_code
)
SELECT SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty_per_unit) AS units_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND sm.model_code = 'SW8-140BLK02-0002';
```

WITH model_units AS (
    -- direct SKU -> model mappings
    SELECT c.child_code AS model_code, c.parent_code AS sku_code, c.qty AS qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT m.child_code AS model_code, b.parent_code AS sku_code, b.qty * m.qty AS qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition b
    JOIN u_composition m
      ON m.parent_kind = 'sku' AND m.child_kind = 'model'
     AND m.parent_code = b.child_code
     AND m.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    WHERE b.parent_kind = 'sku' AND b.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND b.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT SUM(ol.qty * mu.qty_per_sku) AS units
FROM order_line ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN model_units mu ON mu.sku_code = s.sku_code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND mu.model_code = 'AE5-140WAL72-0654';

WITH RECURSIVE
-- All SKUs that contain the target model, with quantity per SKU unit
sku_to_model AS (
    -- direct non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT c.parent_code AS sku_code, c.qty AS qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_code = 'NO5-140OAK03-0391'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    UNION ALL
    -- bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    SELECT b.parent_code AS sku_code, b.qty * m.qty_per_sku AS qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition b
    JOIN sku_to_model m ON b.child_code = m.sku_code

      AND b.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Expand each sold SKU into the company models it contains (directly or via bundles)
sku_models AS (
    -- Direct: non-bundle SKU -> model
    SELECT c.parent_code AS sku_code, c.child_code AS model_code, c.qty AS qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    UNION ALL
